设区域 $D:x^2+y^2\leq R^2$，则 $\iint_D(\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2})dxdy=[\quad]$ $\pi R^4(a^2+b^2)$ $\frac\pi4R^4(\frac1{a^2}+\frac1{b^2})$ $\frac\pi3R^4\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ $\frac\pi2R^4\frac1{a^2+b^2}$ 解答

$$\iint_D\left(\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}\right)dxdy=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^R\left(\frac{r^2}{a^2}\cos^2\theta+\frac{r^2}{b^2}\sin^2\theta\right)rdr$$

$$=\frac{1}{4}R^4\int_0^{2\pi}\left(\frac{1+\cos2\theta}{2a^2}+\frac{1-\cos2\theta}{2b^2}\right)d\theta=\frac{\pi}{4}R^4\left(\frac{1}{a^2}+\frac{1}{b^2}\right).$$
